subject: 赵州桥（安济桥） · 敞肩石拱桥侧立面
author: wanghongliu and Xyklone
source_note: wanghongliu原照、Xyklone裁切，CC0。完整侧立面核对一主拱与四腹拱，河面与背景省略。
prompt: Create a precise, quiet fine black contour architectural study of the Anji/Zhaozhou stone bridge, based on the second image. First Longmen Buddha reference is STYLE ONLY. Show the full LONG side elevation, slightly angled enough to glimpse a little arch soffit, as photo. Essential identifying structure: ONE very wide shallow segmental main stone arch; at EACH shoulder TWO smaller relief arches, four small arches total. Small inner opening on each side higher and narrower, outer opening lower and larger. No additional arches. Gently crowned bridge deck with low stone parapet and regularly spaced small posts matching actual current photo; small carved keystone face. Preserve main arch slender width-to-rise ratio and visibly radial voussoirs. Remove people, trees, all landscape, boats, river ripples, shore stairs and modern railings. Include plain masonry abutment ends just enough to terminate the actual bridge, ample white around whole span. Translate stonework into thin unfilled outlines with selected sparse block joints; 80%wall areas blank. Main and small arch openings white not black. No gray fill, wash, crosshatching or cast shadow. site_recommendation.name: 赵州桥（安济桥）
site_recommendation.lede: 一道低平大拱跨过洨河，两侧肩部再开四个小拱。赵州桥把受力与排水的需要化为明晰轮廓，桥面在其上轻轻隆起。
facts: 安济桥即赵州桥，始建于隋代，传统记载与李春相关。
一座主拱、两肩各两座小拱，构成敞肩式单孔石拱桥。
桥面栏板与局部桥体历经修理，图版依据现状；隋代建造范围不同资料略异。
site_recommendation.yearNote: 省文物局简介为605—616，另有595—605说法；610仅在隋代范围内作约略排序，不表示确切竣工年。
